The volume of the hole is  

\[
6\text{ ft}\times 4\text{ ft}\times 3\text{ ft}=72\text{ ft}^3 .
\]

Bob removes 1 ft³ in 3 seconds, so the total time required is  

\[
72\text{ ft}^3 \times 3\text{ s/ft}^3 = 216\text{ s}.
\]

All three solutions reach the same conclusion, confirming that the calculation is correct.

**Final answer:** 216
